name: FaceZap: 3D World
summary: A puzzle you can reach out and pick up. FaceZap: 3D World brings colorful block puzzles into your space. Use two controllers to grab and turn jelly-like pieces. Place them carefully on the board, or line up a gentle throw. Complete rows and columns, collect ZAP energy and clear space with a well-timed blast. Meet expressive little faces inside glossy, liquid-filled blocks. Look at them up close and watch them react as you prepare a line-clearing move. Choose Classic, Endless or Daily Challenge.
